The '''Kerplunkett Peninsula''', or '''Ostrad Peninsula''', was a peninsula on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] between [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]] and the [[Lianorm Swamp/Legends|swamp]] of [[Lake Paonga/Legends|Lake Paonga]].<ref name="game" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kerplunkett Peninsula and Ostrad Peninsula likely refer to the same location. The game book discusses going around the Ostrad Peninsula if the reader takes the safe route, then in the safe route section calls it the Kerplunkett Peninsula instead.<ref name="Episode I Adventures 11: Pirates from Beyond the Sea">''[[Episode I Adventures 11: Pirates from Beyond the Sea]]'', pages 7-9</ref>
